item.title: Discovering Women Poets, a Poetry Competition — Mon Nov 23, 9:00 AM — https://www.goldengatemarinart.org/
item.description:
The National League of American Pen Women (NLAPW) and the Golden Gate-Marin Branch are launching a poetry competition for women over 18 years of age who are not currently members of the NLAPW. This regional and national competition will be run at the Branch level in the semi-finalist phase. Local winners are automatically entered into the League’s National competition.
Winners at the Branch level will receive $35 and have their entry published in the Branch newsletter. They will also be invited to present their poetry in person or by Zoom.
Branch winners become semi-finalists in the National competition, which will award $100 to three winners. National winners will have their work and a short bio published in The Pen Woman, a national magazine. All semi-finalists will be listed in the magazine.

item.title: Pottery on the Wheel; All Levels — Mon Nov 23, 2:00 PM — Sonoma Community Center
item.description:
Mondays Weekly · 8 Weeks
Date & Time
October 5 – November 23, 2026
2:00 PM – 5:00 PM
Location
Room 117, Ceramics Studio
Category
Ceramics, Extended Classes
Experience Level
All Levels
Ages
17\+

$265
Materials Fee:

Develop and improve your throwing skills while exploring a range of forms through multiple class projects in this all-level throwing class. The instructor guides you through the basic steps of throwing, shaping, and trimming of pottery on the wheel. This class is a great opportunity for studeto hone basic techniques of throwing on the wheel and expand skills in all aspects of pottery. Surface decoration techniques will be explored. With your 8 week class registration, students receive the opportunity to purchase a studio pass for ½ off during the duration of their class. Sign ups for membership will be included in your preclass email
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Healdsburg 5K Turkey Trot — Thu Nov 26, 8:00 AM — 333 Center Street
item.description:
Healdsburg Turkey Trot brings the community together for a Thanksgiving Day 5K fun run and walk through downtown Healdsburg. Starting and finishing in front of Healdsburg Running Company, the event welcomes families, friends and runners of all ages. The volunteer-led event supports the Drew Esquivel Memorial Scholarship, helping Healdsburg High School student-athletes pursue college. Organized by the Rotary Club of Healdsburg Sunrise in partnership with the Healdsburg High School Interact Club and the City of Healdsburg, the trot features awards for the top male and female finishers and youth runners under 13, plus random prizes for festive costumes. Registration is $25 for adults and $20 for children under 12, with $5 discounts available for participants who opt out of receiving a shirt. Participants can also support local students through event sponsorships.
Source: Sonoma.com

item.title: Kenwood Turkey Trot Fun Run — Thu Nov 26, 8:00 AM — Warm Springs Road
item.description:
The Kenwood Turkey Trot Fun Run is an annual Thanksgiving morning tradition welcoming families, friends, and neighbors to enjoy a festive community run or walk. Open to participants of all ages and fitness levels, the event supports the Kenwood Education Foundation and local schools. Held at Kenwood Plaza Park, the event features check-in beginning at 7:45 a.m. and an 8 a.m. start. Participants can kick off Thanksgiving with fresh air, friendly faces, and a fun way to give back to the local community.
Source: Sonoma.com, Visit Santa Rosa

item.title: Marin Farmers Markets — Thu Nov 26, 8:00 AM — Marin Veterans' Memorial Auditorium
item.description:
Price: Free
Sponsor: Marin Center
Explore the bounty of summer at the Marin Farmers Markets. Taste vine-ripened tomatoes, corn that was picked that morning, and peaches so juicy you have to bend over just to get a bite. Farm-fresh eggs, grass-fed beef, artisan c heeses, raw milk, and freshly baked breads complete the shopping exper ience. Specialty prepared foods and handmade art add to the magic of the market.
Enjoy the intimate feeling of the Thursday Marin Farmers Market, an ideal place to meet for lunch and pick up fresh produce for the weekend. Discover the abundance and diversity of product at the celebrated Sunday Marin Farmers Market, the third largest farmers market in California. Turn your dollar into a vote for local sustainable agriculture, shrink your eco-footprint, and revive the feeling of being intimate ly connected to your food by meeting your farmers face-to-face. The market takes place rain or shine.
www.aginstitutemarin.org
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Dem

item.description:

This special tasting features three estate wines paired with festive small bites, offering a delicious introduction to Thanksgiving flavors. The experience includes Brut Rosé Sparkling Wine from Los Carneros paired with cranberry jam and Brie puff pastry bites; the 2023 5th Gen Blend from Sonoma Valley served with cornbread and Spanish chorizo topped with pear chutney; and the 2018 Red Wine from Moon Mountain District paired with bacon-wrapped, blue cheese-stuffed dates with red wine and onion jam.

item.title: Discovering Women Poets, a Poetry Competition — Sat Nov 28, 9:00 AM — https://www.goldengatemarinart.org/
item.description:
The National League of American Pen Women (NLAPW) and the Golden Gate-Marin Branch are launching a poetry competition for women over 18 years of age who are not currently members of the NLAPW. This regional and national competition will be run at the Branch level in the semi-finalist phase. Local winners are automatically entered into the League’s National competition.
Winners at the Branch level will receive $35 and have their entry published in the Branch newsletter. They will also be invited to present their poetry in person or by Zoom.
Branch winners become semi-finalists in the National competition, which will award $100 to three winners. National winners will have their work and a short bio published in The Pen Woman, a national magazine. All semi-finalists will be listed in the magazine.

item.description:
